description: Read one profile: its name, language and time zone, its Instagram connection, and what SmartGenius learned from reading its posts. `instagram.connected` is false until someone connects the account in the studio. `needsReconnect` means the connection broke and a person has to connect it again there. `canReadInsights` says whether per-post numbers can be read (see list_media). `canPublish` and `publishingEnabled` say whether a post could go out from this account at all. `learned` holds the subjects it posts about (each with a weight from 0 to 1), the tone of its captions, its cadence (posts a week, and the weekdays and hours it posts most, hours in `timezone`) and the hashtags it uses most, as of `scannedAt`. It only reads.

profile.description: A profile's handle from list_profiles, or its permanent UUID
